35 def project_facts(entry, today=None):
36     """One registry entry → the facts its home row is made of.
37 
38     ``needs_you``  the strip's human wait, else the last status's "waiting on you" (the fact
39                    behind a needs-you row); ``next`` / ``why`` the strip's next step and its reason;
40                    ``summary`` the last persisted status, parsed once, with ``summary_age_s`` (the
41                    row's steward line reads it from here, not from the file again); ``dated`` the
42                    open steps that carry a ``due`` (soonest first, each with its project);
43                    ``nearest_due`` the first of them; ``has_record`` whether any file existed.
44     """
45     today = today or date.today()
46     entry = entry if isinstance(entry, dict) else {}
47     pid = str(entry.get("id") or "")
48     name = str(entry.get("name") or pid[:8])
49     folder = str(entry.get("folder_path") or "").strip()
50     out = {"id": pid, "name": name, "href": ("/project/%s" % pid) if pid else "",
51            "needs_you": "", "next": "", "why": "", "summary": None, "summary_age_s": None, "dated": [],
52            "nearest_due": "", "has_record": False, "folder": folder, "projection": None}
53     if not folder or not pid:
54         return out
55     root = Path(folder)
56     # the record may live one folder down (the cockpit's own discovery: the root, or a subfolder with a Face);
57     # the card reads the effort touched last and names it (John, 2026-09-27: "I don't see many efforts")
58     rel = current_effort(folder)
59     if rel:
60         root = root / rel
61     out["effort"] = rel
62     strip = _read_json(root / "strip.json")
63     if isinstance(strip, dict):
64         out["has_record"] = True
65         out["needs_you"] = _real_wait(strip.get("human_wait"))
66         out["next"] = str(strip.get("next_recommended") or "").strip()
67         out["why"] = str(strip.get("why_next") or "").strip()
68     sfile = root / ".ecgberht" / "status-summary.json"
69     summ = _read_json(sfile)
70     if isinstance(summ, dict):
71         out["has_record"] = True
72         out["summary"] = summ
73         try:
74             out["summary_age_s"] = max(0.0, time.time() - sfile.stat().st_mtime)
75         except Exception:
76             out["summary_age_s"] = None
77         plan = summ.get("plan") if isinstance(summ.get("plan"), dict) else {}
78         if not out["needs_you"]:
79             out["needs_you"] = _real_wait(plan.get("waiting_on_you"))
80     rm = _read_json(root / "roadmap.json")
81     if isinstance(rm, dict):
82         out["has_record"] = True
83         if not rel:
84             out["projection"] = rm.get("roadmap_projection") or []   # the ROOT record only: a resolver in the same request keys on the project folder
85         dated = []
86         for s in rm.get("roadmap_projection") or []:
87             if not isinstance(s, dict) or s.get("status") not in _OPEN:
88                 continue
89             d = _iso(s.get("due")) if s.get("due") else None
90             if d is None:
91                 continue
92             dated.append({"step_id": str(s.get("id") or ""), "name": str(s.get("name") or ""),
93                           "due": d.isoformat(), "status": str(s.get("status") or ""),
94                           "project_id": pid, "project_name": name})
95         dated.sort(key=lambda x: (x["due"], x["name"]))
96         out["dated"] = dated
97         out["nearest_due"] = dated[0]["due"] if dated else ""
98         # W2 (2026-09-28): what closed — every status flip to done with its INSTANT (the event's `at`, else the
99         # receipt's date at midnight), one per step (the latest), so the head's "since you last opened" can compare
100         # against the real instant of his last page open (Grok W2: the date alone cannot see a second open)
101         names_by_id = {str(s.get("id")): str(s.get("name") or s.get("id") or "") for s in rm.get("roadmap_projection") or [] if isinstance(s, dict)}
102         closed = {}
103         for ev in rm.get("roadmap_events") or []:
104             if not isinstance(ev, dict) or ev.get("kind") != "status_flip" or str(ev.get("to") or "") != "done":
105                 continue
106             rc = ev.get("receipt") if isinstance(ev.get("receipt"), dict) else {}
107             instant = _instant(ev.get("at")) or _instant(rc.get("when"))
108             if instant is None:
109                 continue
110             sid = str(ev.get("step_id") or "")
111             closed[sid] = {"step_id": sid, "name": names_by_id.get(sid, sid), "at": instant, "project_name": name, "project_id": pid}
112         out["closed_recent"] = sorted(closed.values(), key=lambda x: x["at"])
113         # W4 (2026-09-28): the repairs proposed and not yet resolved on his word (the card says "proposed: N corrections")
114         try:
115             from steward_cockpit.repair import open_proposals as _open_proposals
116             props = _open_proposals(rm.get("roadmap_events"))
117             out["repair_proposals"] = [{"proposal_id": str(p.get("proposal_id") or ""), "count": int(p.get("count") or 0)} for p in props]
118         except Exception:
119             out["repair_proposals"] = []
120     # W2 (2026-09-28): the age of the wait — from the record, never the strip's last touch: the earliest instrument
121     # that set the current wait, else the status summary's own time when it carries it; None when unknown
122     out["wait_age_days"] = _wait_age_days(root, out["needs_you"], strip, summ, sfile, today) if out["needs_you"] else None
123     # W5 (2026-09-28): where he left — the strip's last leave receipt (W0's, written on the switch he made), re-read
124     # against the roadmap as it stands now (how many events since); None when he never left this record
125     out["resume"] = _resume(strip, rm if isinstance(rm, dict) else None, rel)
126     # W1 of the steward revision (2026-09-28): EVERY effort's wait, not only the effort touched last — Grok's live
127     # replay (2026-09-27) showed alternating touches hiding the second MBA effort's review from the home. The card
128     # keeps the shown effort for its line; the other efforts' waits ride beside it, each opening its own record.
129     out["efforts"], out["efforts_gap"] = _effort_waits(folder, rel, today)
130     out["other_waits"] = [x for x in out["efforts"] if x["needs_you"] and x["rel"] != rel]
131     if not out["needs_you"] and out["other_waits"]:
132         first = out["other_waits"][0]
133         out["needs_you"] = "%s: %s" % (first["name"], first["needs_you"])
134         out["needs_you_effort"] = first["rel"]
135         out["wait_age_days"] = first.get("age_days")     # the promoted wait's own age (Grok W2)
136     return out

139 def _ago(epoch, now=None):
140     """An instant as words: "just now", "12 min ago", "3 h ago", "2 days ago"; "" when unknown."""
141     if epoch is None:
142         return ""
143     s = max(0, int((now if now is not None else time.time()) - epoch))
144     if s < 90:
145         return "just now"
146     if s < 3600:
147         return "%d min ago" % (s // 60)
148     if s < 86400:
149         return "%d h ago" % (s // 3600)
150     d = s // 86400
151     return "1 day ago" if d == 1 else "%d days ago" % d

154 def _resume(strip, rm, rel=""):
155     """The last `leave` receipt on the strip as the Resume act's fact: the step he was on (named from the roadmap
156     when it can be), when, the effort, and how many roadmap events landed since — so Resume re-reads the state
157     rather than replaying the receipt. None without a receipt."""
158     if not isinstance(strip, dict):
159         return None
160     leaves = [r for r in (strip.get("receipts") or []) if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("kind") == "leave"]
161     if not leaves:
162         return None
163     last = leaves[-1]
164     steps = {str(st.get("id")): st for st in ((rm or {}).get("roadmap_projection") or []) if isinstance(st, dict)}
165     sid = str(last.get("current_step_id") or last.get("last_event_step_id") or "")
166     st = steps.get(sid) or {}
167     events = [e for e in ((rm or {}).get("roadmap_events") or []) if isinstance(e, dict)]
168     last_seq = max([int(e.get("seq") or 0) for e in events] or [0])
169     seen = last.get("last_event_seq")
170     since = max(0, last_seq - int(seen)) if isinstance(seen, int) else None
171     at = _instant(last.get("at"))
172     return {"at": str(last.get("at") or ""), "epoch": at, "ago": _ago(at), "step_id": sid,
173             "step": str(st.get("name") or sid or last.get("active_effort") or "where you were"),
174             "step_status": str(st.get("status") or ""), "effort": rel, "events_since": since,
175             "presentation_id": last.get("presentation_id"), "wait_ref": last.get("wait_ref")}

178 def _instant(v):
179     """An event's instant as epoch seconds: an ISO datetime, or a date (midnight, local); None when neither."""
180     s = str(v or "").strip()
181     if not s:
182         return None
183     try:
184         from datetime import datetime as _dt, timezone as _tz
185         if len(s) <= 10:
186             return _dt.combine(date.fromisoformat(s[:10]), _dt.min.time()).timestamp()
187         s2 = s.replace("Z", "+00:00")
188         d = _dt.fromisoformat(s2)
189         if d.tzinfo is None:
190             d = d.replace(tzinfo=_tz.utc)
191         return d.timestamp()
192     except Exception:
193         return None

196 def _wait_age_days(root, wait, strip, summ, sfile, today):
197     """Days the current wait has stood, from the record: the ``as_of`` of the earliest instrument in the latest run
198     that carries this wait text; else the status summary's ``waiting_since`` (the composer's stamp from the managed
199     request's own time) when its plan carries the same wait; else None — no number without a reader, and never the
200     strip's or the summary's own last touch."""
201     try:
202         w = " ".join(str(wait or "").split()).lower()
203         since = None
204         ins = strip.get("instruments") if isinstance(strip, dict) else None
205         if isinstance(ins, list):
206             for i in reversed(ins):
207                 if not isinstance(i, dict) or "human_wait" not in i:
208                     continue
209                 if " ".join(str(i.get("human_wait") or "").split()).lower() == w:
210                     since = _iso(i.get("as_of")) or since
211                     continue
212                 break
213         if since is None and isinstance(summ, dict):
214             # the status summary is rewritten every ten minutes, so its own `at` is the strip's last touch in
215             # another form — only a `waiting_since` the composer stamps from the decision's time counts
216             plan = summ.get("plan") if isinstance(summ.get("plan"), dict) else {}
217             if " ".join(str(plan.get("waiting_on_you") or "").split()).lower() == w and plan.get("waiting_since"):
218                 since = _iso(str(plan.get("waiting_since") or "")[:10])
219         if since is None:
220             return None
221         return max(0, (today - since).days)
222     except Exception:
223         return None

226 def _effort_waits(folder, shown_rel="", today=None):
227     """Every steward effort of a project (the cockpit's own discovery: the root with a Face, plus one level of
228     subfolders with their own) with its wait — the strip's human wait, else the last status's "waiting on you" —
229     and the wait's age from that effort's record, as ``([{rel, name, needs_you, age_days, shown}], gap)`` in the
230     cockpit's order. Read-only; never raises. A failure is never a silent empty list (Grok W1: that would recreate
231     the hidden second effort): the gap names it and the card shows it."""
232     today = today or date.today()
233     try:
234         from steward_cockpit.steward_campaign import discover_efforts
235         efforts = discover_efforts(str(folder)) or []
236     except Exception as e:
237         return [], "the project's efforts could not be listed: %s" % (type(e).__name__)
238     out, gap = [], ""
239     for e in efforts:
240         try:
241             rel = str((e or {}).get("rel") or "")
242             root = Path(folder) / rel if rel else Path(folder)
243             wait = ""
244             strip = _read_json(root / "strip.json")
245             if isinstance(strip, dict):
246                 wait = _real_wait(strip.get("human_wait"))
247             sfile = root / ".ecgberht" / "status-summary.json"
248             summ = _read_json(sfile)
249             if not wait:
250                 plan = summ.get("plan") if isinstance(summ, dict) and isinstance(summ.get("plan"), dict) else {}
251                 wait = _real_wait(plan.get("waiting_on_you"))
252             out.append({"rel": rel, "name": str((e or {}).get("name") or rel or "root"), "needs_you": wait,
253                         "age_days": _wait_age_days(root, wait, strip, summ, sfile, today) if wait else None,
254                         "shown": rel == str(shown_rel or "")})
255         except Exception as ex:
256             gap = "%s could not be read: %s" % (str((e or {}).get("name") or "an effort"), type(ex).__name__)
257     return out, gap

260 def _real_wait(text):
261     """The cockpit's own rule for a wait (steward_campaign._real_wait, called directly — no second list, Grok R7): a
262     strip that says "none" / "nothing" / "-" / "none — explanation" is not waiting on anyone, so its project has no
263     business on Needs you (the live board showed "Needs you: none" on four cards, 2026-09-27)."""
264     return str(_cockpit_wait(text) or "").strip()

267 def current_effort(folder):
268     """The effort the card shows: of the efforts the cockpit discovers (the root when it has a Face, plus one level
269     of subfolders with their own ECGBERHT.md), the one the cockpit itself lists first — by its own clock,
270     ``steward_campaign.last_touched`` (the conversation log, the strip, the roadmap), the same sort the cockpit's
271     efforts row uses; "" for the root or when no effort exists. Read-only; never raises."""
272     try:
273         from steward_cockpit.steward_campaign import discover_efforts, last_touched
274         efforts = discover_efforts(str(folder)) or []
275     except Exception:
276         return ""
277     best, best_t = "", -1.0
278     for e in efforts:
279         rel = str((e or {}).get("rel") or "")
280         try:
281             t = float(last_touched(str(Path(folder) / rel if rel else Path(folder))) or 0.0)
282         except Exception:
283             t = 0.0
284         if t > best_t:
285             best, best_t = rel, t
286     return best

300 def week_in_words(today=None):
301     """The week header in words: 'this week Sep 22–28' (Monday to Sunday of today's week)."""
302     today = today or date.today()
303     mon = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())
304     sun = mon + timedelta(days=6)
305 
306     def md(d):
307         return "%s %d" % (d.strftime("%b"), d.day)
308     if mon.month == sun.month:
309         return "this week %s–%d" % (md(mon), sun.day)
310     return "this week %s – %s" % (md(mon), md(sun))

313 def due_label(iso, today=None):
314     """'overdue since Sep 20' · 'due today' · 'due Oct 8' — the same date, said against today."""
315     d = _iso(iso)
316     if not d:
317         return ""
318     today = today or date.today()
319     if d < today:
320         return "overdue since " + short_date(iso)
321     if d == today:
322         return "due today"
323     return "due " + short_date(iso)
324

326 def short_date(iso):
327     """'2026-10-08' → 'Oct 8'; anything else comes back as it is."""
328     d = _iso(iso)
329     return ("%s %d" % (d.strftime("%b"), d.day)) if d else str(iso or "")
